objective: Use SATA as a private accounting metric for agent-to-agent work across G:\ and approved external workspaces so compute is spent efficiently and token waste is reduced.

computeBudget.source: GitHub Pro subscription and approved agent compute budget
computeBudget.tokenBudgetSource: actual measured token usage where available; otherwise estimate until instrumentation exists

sataUnit.name: agent SATA
sataUnit.conversionPolicy: No market conversion. Agent SATA is earned and spent only inside private use_case ledgers.

transactionTypes.description: A proposed private SATA price before delegated agent work begins.
A requesting agent accepts a quote and reserves private SATA budget.
Payment for completed delegated work with evidence.
Payment for independent review, validation, or defect discovery.
Bonus for reusable evidence or measurable future token savings.
Penalty for avoidable rework, missing evidence, or duplicated effort.
Return of reserved private SATA for rejected, failed, or out-of-scope work.
Final closeout after evidence, review, and budget accounting.

pricingModel.tokenCostRule: Estimate private SATA cost from expected tokens until actual token instrumentation is available.
pricingModel.riskPremiumRule: Increase quote for cross-project context, external-write risk, irreversible changes, or financial-adjacent work.
pricingModel.reuseDiscountRule: Discount work that uses existing artifacts, validated scripts, prior reports, or durable templates.
pricingModel.evidenceBonusRule: Award bonus when the work creates a reusable artifact that reduces future token use.
pricingModel.penaltyRule: Apply penalty for hallucinated work, missing evidence, avoidable duplication, or scope overrun.
